description: This PHP source file defines a class 'MyReviewMenuConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It configures a menu related to performance reviews in the OrangeHRM system by overriding the current module and screen context.

classes.name: MyReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that implements menu configuration for performance review related screens, overriding the current screen context to 'myPerformanceReview'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'myPerformanceReview' in the current module context, used to set up the menu display for performance reviews.
